name: Zemo: Thunderbolts
notes: Zemo leads the Thunderbolts: Citizen V (his own alias), Songbird, MACH-1, Fixer, Moonstone, Radioactive Man, Bob and Valentina, all mono-black. Every black spell you cast from hand makes Zemo connive, and Valentina turns your Villains into Heroes she can connive again every turn.
Turns 1–3: Songbird, MACH-1, Fixer, Bob or Boomerang. Baron Strucker and Tombstone make every Villain cost {1} less.

Turns 4–6: Zemo connives off every black spell. Citizen V puts a +1/+1 counter on every Villain each time you gain life, and Songbird, Boomerang, Undead Hand Ninja, Criminal Enterprise and Void Helix gain life constantly. Valentina taps to make a Hero (all your Villains) connive.

Closing: Crimson Cowl adds a menace Villain each attack and The Masters of Evil pumps the team. Once Zemo has attacked, his Boast recasts heavy black cards from the graveyard: Elektra, Void Helix, Ultimo, Green Goblin and Sandman's Quicksand all have two black symbols. Count Nefaria drops in cheap after any sacrifice, and Grim Reaper's Scythe makes Zombies whenever you return creatures from the graveyard.

Bracket 2: Thunderbolts outside black (Red Guardian, U.S.Agent, Yelena's white card, Ghost, Taskmaster, Atlas) aren't legal in mono-black. Most of them are in the Winter Soldier deck instead. White Widow, Yelena Belova (black) comes from the Lethal packet; add her if you have it. Thunderbolts Conspiracy brings your Villains back as Heroes when they die, and Elektra adds removal plus two more black symbols for Boast. M.O.D.O.K., Evil Intellect makes an opponent sacrifice a creature whenever you draw your second card in a turn, which Zemo's connives trigger constantly. Doctor Doom is the next rare to chase.

Set tags: MSH = Marvel Super Heroes, SPM = Marvel's Spider-Man, MSC = Marvel Super Heroes Commander and Jumpstart cards. Every card listed is one you own. Hot Dog Cart and Dependable Quinjet are in all five Marvel B2 decks; some other commons and uncommons are shared too.

notes: Nov 15 generic sim: the planned Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and Fellwar Stone for three Swamps added 0.35 mana on turn 4 but no win rate (21.8% to 20.3%, inside noise). Zemo connives on black spells and a rock is not one, so only Sol Ring is kept.

Against: Toxic Deluge kills your own Villains too.
